thread:
ashley: Heads-up — since ~08:10 we've seen a regional uptick in ECC+Xid noise in us-west-2. Capacity visible to autoscaler is down ~6.8% vs baseline and tail latency for short-reqs spiked 2x. I'm opening this thread to collect data and propose immediate mitigations.

kai: saw the alert. Is it concentrated to a rack/instance type or spread?

ashley: initial look shows concentration on older A100-p4b nodes (rack r12/r13) but there are some isolated reports on newer hosts too. Quick grep from telemetry: `grep -E "CE|Xid" /var/log/gpu-health/last24h | wc -l` => 1836 in last 6h; baseline ~240.

infra-bot: [alert] GPU-ECC-SPIKE us-west-2: 6.7% capacity loss, affected hosts=48, severity=high. See /alerts/2112233344 for details.

ryan_sre: can we get a breakdown by Xid code? need to know if this is a thermal/ecc vs driver-level problem.

ashley: paste from quick aggregation: `Xid 13: 1200, Xid 31: 260, CE: 376` — most Xid13. Stack traces show `nvdec` in some, others show `nv_peer_mem`.

ben_ops: hold on any auto-provision purchases until we decide — procurement put a tentative hold flag on new GPU orders earlier this week, seems like a good time to keep it. @cloud-billing do you concur?

cloud-billing: confirmed — we can pause the next reserved commit window. cost impact analysis: if we route load to other regions (us-east-1 / eu-west-1) we expect +12-18% egress & inter-region overhead. I'll model numbers if we need to burst.

natalie_prod: customer-facing note: any ETA on mitigation? some SLOs are getting close to alert. We should decide if a customer notice is needed.

kai: short-term ops: 1) isolate most noisy hosts by adding `gpu-health=quarantine` label 2) set drain-window to 15m for affected nodes 3) fallback routing to dedicated cold pool in region + cross-region spill if cold pool < 20% capacity. I can run the node tagging script.

ashley: doing step 1 now. command: ```
for n in $(kubectl get nodes -l gpu=true -o name | grep r12); do
  kubectl label $n gpu-health=quarantine || true
done
```

ryan_sre: propose we run a short canary batch of inference on a quarantined node after warm reboot and driver rollback to 525.90. Try to reproduce Xid13. If it clears, we can unquarantine; if not, schedule replace. Also recommend bumping telemetry retention for device logs to 72h for the affected hosts.

ben_ops: replacement runway: we have ~14 spare nodes pre-provisioned in us-west-2 but they require some image bake and security validation (~3h). If we go heavy on replacements we'll burn budget fast. Suggest replacing only nodes that fail repro.

ashley: updated telemetry: pushed retention bump and started repro job on 3 suspect hosts. job id `repro-211223-01`. Early output: one host repro'd Xid13 on first run after `modprobe -r nvidia && modprobe nvidia` — looks like soft-resetable.

natalie_prod: recommend status update to customers in impacted clusters if we hit >10% resource degradation sustained for >2h. currently at 6.8% for ~40m. I'll draft a note and hold until next check.

cloud-billing: running cost modeling quick: cross-region spill (10% of traffic to us-east-1) estimated incremental monthly cost = $48k. Post here if we decide to enact.

ryan_sre: also flag to infra-team: let's pause any mass driver rollouts in us-west-2 until we confirm root cause; recent driver push may have increased sensitivity on older cards.

kai: operational checklist I'm executing now: 1) label & drain noisy nodes 2) repro + driver rollback on 3 nodes 3) mark failing nodes for replacement if repro persists 4) enable cross-region spill if degraded >10% or repro failure >30% of sampled hosts 5) notify @oncall and support channels.

ashley: adding note for later RCA: correlate ambient rack temps with ECC counts (we saw slight rise in datacenter cooling alarm ~07:50) and check firmware revision mismatch across r12/r13. Also want to compare nvlink error counts.

ben_ops: agree on selective replacement only. Also ask procurement to prioritize newer Ampere refresh when buying replacement capacity (power/thermal profile seems better).

infra-bot: [update] repro job `repro-211223-01` completed for 3 hosts: 2 repro'd Xid13 after soft reset; 1 cleared. Action: schedule replacement for the 2 repro hosts.

natalie_prod: drafted customer note and context ready. Waiting on confirmation to send if we cross 10% sustained for >2h.

kai: scheduling rolling replacements for repro'd hosts starting in 30m. will use stagger 3-per-10m to avoid slamming provisioning.

cloud-billing: noted. if we do replacements using on-demand vs reserved spares cost delta today estimated at +$9k for the week.

ryan_sre: follow-up items for RCA: collect driver stack traces, firmware versions, nvlink health, and power-supply error logs. I'll own the triage doc.

ashley: thanks team. I'll post another update in 30m with replacement progress and any change to capacity numbers. :thumbsup:
